name: Panathenaia
summary: Athena's birthday festival and the city's greatest procession: games, torch-races, and the peplos woven with the Gigantomachy carried up to the goddess on the Acropolis.
testimonia: Harpocration s.v. Παναθήναια (the birthday on 28 Hekatombaion)
Euripides, Hecuba 466–474 (the peplos woven with the battle of the giants)
Mikalson, The Sacred and Civil Calendar of the Athenian Year (1975) 23, 33–34
